assumptions: Fragment lengths must fall in the stated window.
Ligation efficiency and fidelity are the measured Potapov 2018 T4 ligase data.
limits: Ranks arrangements by the overhangs only; synthesis difficulty of each fragment is not scored.
bio.jane/contract.question: Where should one sequence be cut into Golden Gate fragments so that the overhangs the cuts create ligate efficiently and faithfully?

description: Decide where to CUT one sequence into Golden Gate fragments, optimising the split positions and the overhangs they create together. Where design_overhang_set proposes junctions for parts you already have, this fragments a sequence you are about to order: it searches every legal arrangement of fragments in your length window and ranks them by the measured ligation efficiency and fidelity of the overhangs each arrangement produces. Ported from OOGGA (Mukundan & Madhusudhan 2025) and scored against the same Potapov 2018 T4 ligase data the fidelity tools use.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

alien_overhangs.description: junctions already committed elsewhere in the assembly (a fixed vector's own ends), which this set must not collide with. Advanced.

dataset.description: the measured ligation matrix to score against. OOGGA's own published choice is the T4 18 h 37 C set. Values: BsaI-HFv2 (BsaI-HFv2, Golden Gate cycling (4 nt)), BsmBI-v2 (BsmBI-v2, Golden Gate cycling (4 nt)), Esp3I (Esp3I, Golden Gate cycling (4 nt)), BbsI-HF (BbsI-HF, Golden Gate cycling (4 nt)), SapI (SapI, Golden Gate cycling (3 nt)), T4-01h-25C (T4 DNA ligase, 1 h at 25 C (4 nt)), T4-01h-37C (T4 DNA ligase, 1 h at 37 C (4 nt)), T4-18h-25C (T4 DNA ligase, 18 h at 25 C (4 nt)), T4-18h-37C (T4 DNA ligase, 18 h at 37 C (4 nt)). Advanced.

efficiency_weight.description: exponent on the running ligation EFFICIENCY — raise it to favour junctions that ligate readily. Efficiency and fidelity are different failure modes: a junction can ligate eagerly and promiscuously. Advanced.

exclude_from.description: start of a span no cut may fall in — a feature you need kept intact. Use with exclude_to. Advanced.

exclude_to.description: end of that span, exclusive. Only applies when exclude_from is set. Advanced.

fidelity_weight.description: exponent on the running FIDELITY — raise it to favour junctions that ligate to the right partner rather than a mismatched one. Advanced.

fragments.description: pin the number of fragments instead of letting the search choose. Leave empty to take whatever the length window allows.

max_length.description: longest allowed fragment, in bases — the vendor's upper limit, or the length you can sequence in one read.

max_overhang_identity.description: most positions two overhangs in the set may share before they are treated as confusable. Lower is stricter and rules out more arrangements. Advanced.

min_length.description: shortest allowed fragment, in bases — usually what your synthesis vendor will accept.

sequence.description: the sequence to fragment, in one piece. Leave it empty to fragment the open record.

traces.description: how many ranked alternatives to return. The best arrangement is rarely the only acceptable one, and the runner-up often avoids a site you care about.

name: design_split_sites

alternatives.description: the other ranked arrangements, each with its own breaks, score and junctions — the best is rarely the only acceptable one

breaks.description: the winning arrangement's cut positions, in reading order

candidates.description: how many arrangements were feasible at all under these constraints

dataset.description: the measured matrix actually scored against

fragment_count.description: how many fragments the winning arrangement needs

fragments.description: the fragments to order: sequence, span, length and the overhang at each end. Consecutive fragments overlap by exactly the four-base junction

net_efficiency.description: net ligation efficiency across every junction, 0-1

overhangs.description: the junctions the winning arrangement creates — wire this straight into score_overhang_fidelity to grade the set it chose

report.description: the whole result, every arrangement in full

score.description: the objective for the winning arrangement: net efficiency^w x net fidelity^w
